data.title: 爱夏·晨光中的账目核对
data.action: 左手压住账册，右手用羽毛笔圈出一项数字
data.description: 晨光从书桌左侧照入。爱夏坐在桌后，左手压住摊开的账册，右手的羽毛笔停在刚圈出的数字上，眉梢微挑。深褐连衣裙与白色围裙保持整齐；前景的收据束与后方的分类书架交代宅邸事务，焦点落在脸、笔尖和账页之间。
data.promptProse: At an oak desk, Aisha pauses with her quill touching a circled entry in an open household ledger. Her left palm holds the page flat while her raised eyebrow suggests she has found a discrepancy. Seen across the near desk corner in a waist-up view, she sits between a bundle of receipts in the foreground and labeled storage shelves behind her. Sunlight from the window on the left illuminates her face, the writing hand and the paper together; the far shelves remain softly shaded.
